title: Declining to go west and staying in New York to find tunes
summary: The band returned from California raving about the trip; Challis stayed in New York to deal with publishers while they filmed.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: He made a big fuss over it for awhile. I could see his point to a certain extent. Andy has done better choruses, but it's just the way things happened, so it was left in but at that time the band come back and the boys had all been out there and they told me what a wonderful time they had. And the -- but one of the guys got killed. I think Joe was riding with him. Mario Perry. They all had cars, they all had houses and they all got paid, all the time they didn't make the picture.

And you know, all I could hear was, 'You should have been along.' We met so and so and they all had young starlets and things. They must have had a real ball. But the band came back and then they went out again later on to make the picture. When something was straightened out, the book was straightened out and a couple of things, and at that time Paul said, 'You better come out with us this time,' and I said, 'I got a car here and I got an apartment here and I don't know what to do with all that.'
He said, 'Can't you sublet them or something like that, something like that, he said. Anyway he says, 'Okay, if you don't

want to go it's all right." He said, "I have to have somebody here to talk with Phil [Kornhiser] and a couple of the guys that the -- the publishers and get tunes from them and you can do that, and we'll go out.
